Accordingly, beginning with the first quarter of 2024, the Company's reportable segments will change:
• the Company will report the financial position and results of operations of its ISS, dewatering and assessment services businesses in a new segment referred to as Water Solutions and Services;
• the Company's Water Infrastructure reportable segment will no longer include the results of the dewatering business; and
• the Company's Measurement and Control Solutions reportable segment will no longer include the results of the assessment services business.
The Company's Applied Water reportable segment will remain unchanged.
